summary: Targeted re-test of the empty-state validation guard for the free 'COMPONI DESCRIZIONE (GRATIS)' button on /crea (CardEditor.jsx composeFree). Both scenarios from the review request now PASS end-to-end. Scenario 1 (NEGATIVE): logged in as mago@grimorio.it / arcano123, navigated to /crea with default type=spell, EMPTY name-field and all attributes empty. Clicked compose-free-btn -> error toast 'Compila prima nome e qualche statistica' is shown AND desc-field remained empty (''). ZERO network requests fired during the click (0 total, 0 to /api/ai/*). Scenario 2 (POSITIVE): filled name-field='Fulmine Arcano' and attr-livello=3, then clicked compose-free-btn -> desc-field populated with 'Fulmine Arcano è una magia di livello 3.' and success toast 'Descrizione composta gratis (nessun credito usato)' shown. Again ZERO network requests fired (0 total, 0 to /api/ai/*), confirming the feature is fully client-side. The iteration_6 bug is fixed by the new guard at CardEditor.jsx L106-114 (hasName + hasAttr check before building parts[]).

ai_feature_verdicts.capability: Free client-side description composer (composeFree in CardEditor.jsx)
ai_feature_verdicts.notes: Empty-state guard now blocks empty input with correct Italian toast and no field mutation. Positive path still works and provably makes zero /api/ai/* calls.

critical_code_review_comments: CardEditor.jsx L104-114: fix looks correct — the new guard computes hasName (trimmed) and hasAttr (recursively over Array/object attribute values, ignoring empty strings and '-'), returning early with toast.error before parts[] is built. This matches the spec and blocks the previously-reported bug.
The legacy fallback guard at L200 (`description === \`${name}.\``) is now unreachable for non-custom types but harmless; consider removing to keep the function lean.
